en: Before you take on the Pokémon League, battle me one more time. Every battle makes us stronger, right?
{player}... Thanks to you, I did what I set out to do on this journey. My sister's Purrloin is home.
I wish you could have seen her face. This is my thanks!
You're seriously amazing. So go and become the Champion! Show everyone the kind of Trainer your Pokémon are proud of!
